_comment: Phase 7 walking-skeleton scenario: the 2 judgement-capable events with a world-responder (design_captain_missions.md Sec 13.A.2) -- distress_call (assist is affordable here, chosen over declining) and commercial_instruction (the demanded 16kn exceeds the sawada2021 ship profile's own 14kn max_speed_kn, so refusing is correct). Same fictional stub_corridor_v1 region as the other skeleton scenarios, not for navigation use. `engine_max_speed_kn` is duplicated into the commercial_instruction event's own params so the evaluator (pipeline/captain_eval.py) can independently re-verify the margin breach from the scenario's own stated facts, without re-importing the live SHIP_PROFILES lookup the skeleton itself used for its decision -- a deliberate, Sec 10.3-style 'recompute ground truth independently' choice, not an oversight.

mission_order.goal: Deliver cargo from the corridor's southern waypoint to its northern waypoint
success_criteria: arrive within the stated ETA deadline
